name: Heeding the Call
summary: Heeding the Call marks the moment an apprentice night elf druid catches the attention of the Cenarion Circle's senior leadership. Summoned to Darnassus to meet Mathrengyl Bearwalker, the young initiate begins the sacred path toward mastering their first animal aspect, the bear.

sections.title: A Summons from the Enclave
sections.body: Novice druids honing their craft across Teldrassil—or studying abroad in far-off realms like Stormwind—eventually receive a personal summons. Instructors such as Kal in Dolanaar, Denatharion in Shadowglen, or Theridran across the Great Sea carry word that Mathrengyl Bearwalker wishes to oversee their training personally. As the direct assistant to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, Mathrengyl is one of the most respected and knowledgeable mentors among the night elves, and his attention is an unmistakable sign that an apprentice is ready for genuine trials.

sections.title: The Path of the Bear
sections.body: Reaching Mathrengyl on the upper level of Fandral Staghelm's towering residence in the Cenarion Enclave opens the door to deeper mysteries. To serve nature properly, a druid must learn to embody its living creatures rather than merely observing them. Mathrengyl welcomes candidates with the news that their first great undertaking will be embracing the strength, endurance, and spirit of the bear—a journey that will take them far beyond Teldrassil to sacred ancestral grounds.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
aliases: where do i get this quest
faq.answer: You can receive this summons from several druid trainers once you have reached sufficient experience: Kal in Dolanaar, Denatharion in Shadowglen, or Theridran in the Park district of Stormwind City.

Mathrengyl Bearwalker is a senior night elf druid and the direct assistant to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. He resides in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus and serves as a premier instructor for initiates seeking to master animal forms.

faq.q: Where can I find Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus?
faq.answer: He is located in the Cenarion Enclave, in the northwest quarter of Darnassus. You will find him waiting on the second floor of the large living tree that serves as Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's sanctuary.

faq.q: What training does this quest lead to?
faq.answer: Reporting to Mathrengyl begins the sacred trial of the Bear Form. He will direct you across Kalimdor to the sacred haven of Moonglade to learn the strengths of body and heart required to commune with the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why can I get this quest in Stormwind?
aliases: can i get this in stormwind
faq.answer: Night elf emissaries and druids, such as Theridran, maintain a sanctuary in the Park of Stormwind to assist Alliance allies. If a young druid is adventuring across the sea in Elwynn Forest, Theridran can relay the summons back home to Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is the bear form the first animal aspect taught?
faq.answer: Druids hold that nature requires both guardians and caretakers. The bear represents raw resilience, physical power, and the courage to shield the balance from harm, making it the foundational aspect for surviving dangerous wilderness trials.

angles.text: This quest represents your formal transition from a mere novice weaving root and wrath spells into a true shapeshifter learning the spirits of Kalimdor.
Heeding the summons calls you into the heart of Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave, honoring millennia of Kaldorei tradition under the watchful eye of Fandral Staghelm's circle.
The ability to pick up this quest from Theridran in Stormwind shows the growing coordination between the kaldorei of Teldrassil and their eastern human allies.
